pages.title: Copy from a Frame
pages.text: Keep an unused map in the atlas supplies. Sneak-right-click a filled frame with the atlas. If that map is new to the atlas, this spends one empty map and copies the sheet and its pins into a free slot.

pages.title: Copy to a Frame
pages.text: Select a filled sheet in the atlas and sneak-right-click an empty frame. This spends one empty map to display a copy. Both copies can keep their own waypoints.

pages.title: Transfer Waypoints
pages.text: When the framed map matches the atlas’s selected sheet, sneak-right-click it again to open the transfer screen. Choose the direction to copy the pins. If the matching sheet was in another slot, the first use selects it.
